brief: A premium instalment, lending and accounting platform for merchants and lenders, built Arabic-first and live in five languages. It should feel like private banking: calm, exact and dignified, with one warm metal.
criteria: Success: distinct from blue fintech marks, recognisable at 16 px, works in one colour, equally at home in Arabic and Latin.

concepts.name: Plumb q
concepts.idea: A lowercase wordmark whose q ends in a gold plumb-bob: the true, level measure that a balance stands for.
rationale: Qistas means the just balance; the plumb-bob is the oldest symbol of true and level
One gold accent only: the bob in Latin, the two qaf dots in Arabic
Custom geometric letters on one grid; Arabic outlined and weight-matched
Holds at 16 px, in one colour and reversed

recommendation: Plumb q is the chosen direction: ownable, calm and exact, and it carries a dual-script identity from day one.
next_steps: Native-speaker review of Arabic and Urdu copy
Phase 1 build: first three screens in Flutter
